neighbours.label: the word after an anticipation/eagerness predicate ('can't wait to/for', 'glad when', 'counting the days until')
fire: The students could hardly wait for the summer break to start.
We are so eager to see our grandchildren again.
He kept counting the hours until the plane landed.
I'll be relieved when the exams are finally over.
She can't wait until her brother comes home.
Fans are looking forward to the new season.
The dog waits by the door for its owner every evening.
They were thrilled to finally move into the new house.
quiet: The students walked home for the summer break.
We are so proud of our grandchildren.
He kept checking the map while the plane landed.
I'll be studying when the exams are finally over.
She cooks dinner when her brother comes home.
Fans are talking about the new season.
The dog sleeps by the door every evening.
They were told to move into the new house.

notes: card: ' to'/' for'/' until' after wait, glad; probe 0.74-1.09 vs 0.07-0.18
